title: Descent of normalization arrows relative to fixed etale levels
statement: Let X,Y,g,d,M,U be as in the adic tower setup [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Give etale B_n-complexes D_n on U.left, each cohomologically bounded, and isomorphisms from the explicit fixed realization of comparisonUpperStar(D_n) to the pulled actual M.level n [def-weil-pbc-lisse-tower-etale-descent-data]. Then LisseTowerEtaleNormalization X Y g d M U D is inhabited. In particular, it supplies descended delta_n, their coherent local universality, the constant-arrow local universality and coefficient coherence, and all localized realization/model/actual/scalar data with the two prescribed equations. It does not construct the levels D_n, does not assert their finite local constancy, does not involve algebraic models K_n or local markings, and does not supply any Isom stalk inhabitance.

source.place: Tags 099Z and 09B1, bounded-below classical comparison; Tag 099Y, finite local systems; Tag 09BV, local Isom torsors; derived base change of Tag 06YY.

proof.text: Take the uniquely section-normalized scalar squares from lem-weil-pbc-lisse-tower-scalar-restriction. Transport each actual restricted transition along the supplied e_(n+1), the restricted inverse of e_n, and the inverse derived scalar square. Exact restriction preserves the lower cohomological bound on D_n. Apply the existing ProEtale.bijective_comparisonUpperStar_mapDerivedCategory_map to the source and target, and the fully faithful fixed realization equivalence, to obtain delta_n. The proof explicitly cancels the inverse scalar square and e_n to prove its descent equation.

The scalar-square theorem supplies source-site universality of the lifted delta_n and of every universal algebraic constant arrow at that quotient. The independently proved etaleNormalization_coherence supplies the coherence of delta_n and of constants for every algebraic k, including non-universal k. Assemble these as local_delta, local_constant_universal and constant_coherence. No cyclic scalar-extension/local-systems theorem is imported.

Use the explicit lisseTowerLocalRealization: fixed-coefficient inverse image along f.left followed by the prescribed fixed realization on W. Apply lisseTower_localized_realization to the constructed delta_n and their proved descent equations. Its model, actual, scalar and two normalization equations fill the remaining fields of LisseTowerEtaleNormalization. No arbitrary realization functor is chosen and the original statement is unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Tags 099Z and 09B1; explicit bounded-below full-faithfulness lift of actual arrows. Source universality is isolated with the fixed coefficient square, and localized model comparisons are a separate genuine step. The inverse-compositor coherence is proved directly from ordinary coefficient composition and exact-localization square pasting, without importing cyclic scalar-extension infrastructure.

from.place: Descent of normalization arrows relative to fixed etale levels; the separate finite-level and normalization steps of lem-weil-pbc-lisse-tower-etale-descent.

lean.statement:
theorem lisse_tower_etale_normalization_descent
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (M : AdicTower X d)
    (U : Y.ProEt)
    (D : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf U.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n))))
    (hbounded : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (D n)))
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ, (lisseTowerFixedRealization (U.hom ≫ g) d n).obj
      ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)) U.left).mapDerivedCategory.obj (D n)) ≅
      (adicTowerPullback (U.hom ≫ g) ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n)) :
    Nonempty (LisseTowerEtaleNormalization X Y g d M U D)
